analysis.calibration: Known answer accepted; shifted clock, missing events, zero counter and NaN rejected.
analysis.change: Read actual Spectre PSF filename; no criteria or simulator input changes.

contract.limitation: Saved-point/event observations only; no continuous-time or performance qualification.
contract.oracle: Single-shot start or start+k*period; held schedule 0.125 us + k*0.25 us; exact event count.

failure.action: Preserve failed run; new run uses explicit reltol=1e-6 on both backends, same external criteria.
failure.message: cannot certify same-time forward error at dut:next: bound 5.293955920339377e-23, budget 0e0

earlier_attempts.failure: VACOMP-1795: leading decimal point in .125e-6/.1e-6 rejected during AHDL read-in. Both backends use leading-zero source in r3. No verdict about timer semantics from these failed compilations.

raw_artifacts: EVAS r4 local; unchanged Spectre r3 local and thu-sui. Raw bundle is local, not a public full replay package.
result_scope: Six development cases, same VA per backend in r3. Saved counter/event checks against fixed mathematical schedules; excludes the original 31-condition denominator, holdout qualification, and speed claims.
